workload.name: bank-support-duplicate-payment
workload.description: One retail-banking support ticket (a duplicated debit card payment that caused an overdraft fee) and ten questions in a fixed order that cycles choice (4 options), score (4 levels), noul. A run with q questions sends the first q.

settings.percentileMethod: linear interpolation between closest ranks (Hyndman-Fan type 7, the NumPy and Excel PERCENTILE.INC default)

measurements.title: Model forward pass
measurements.what: Time inside ONNX Runtime's Run call for the request's single batched forward pass (DecisionDiagnostics.ModelMilliseconds). On a GPU it includes copying the inputs to the device and the logits back. Excludes tokenising, building the rows and post-processing.

measurements.title: Engine end to end
measurements.what: Stopwatch around OnnxDecisionEngine.DecideAsync on an already-parsed request: routing, tokenising, building the rows, the forward pass (including host-device copies) and the reference post-processing. No HTTP, no JSON.

measurements.title: Model forward pass, varied inputs
measurements.what: As 'Model forward pass', but each of 150 requests per cell uses the workload's text cut to a different word count this process hasn't sent before (5 upwards, shuffled with a fixed seed), with no warm-up on those shapes. This is closer to real traffic than the fixed workload: a GPU runtime can't reuse shape-specific work.

measurements.title: Engine end to end, varied inputs
measurements.what: As 'Engine end to end', with the varied inputs above. The input-tokens column is the mean over the requests.

settings.percentileMethod: linear interpolation between closest ranks (Hyndman-Fan type 7, the NumPy and Excel PERCENTILE.INC default)

measurements.title: HTTP end to end
measurements.what: Client-side wall time for one POST /v1/systemone over a kept-alive localhost connection: sending the JSON body, the Runtime's parsing, validation and inference, and reading and deserialising the response into the contract types.

measurements.title: Model forward pass as reported by the Runtime
measurements.what: The x-tau-model-ms response header of the same requests: the forward-pass time measured inside the server. The gap between this and the HTTP figure is what HTTP, JSON and the host add.
